title: H3 quality ladder re-tier: native drops to medium, a new 1664x960 high on top
description: The `high` tier was H3's native 1344x768, and at that size the model's output is draft-grade - only usable for extreme close-ups (user, 2026-09-06). Shift the whole 1K ladder down one rung so the labels describe the output: old `low` -> `very_low`, old `medium` -> `low`, native -> `medium`, and a NEW `high` at 1664x960 (1:1 960, 9:16 960x1664, 21:9 1792x768). Old `very_low` (320x576) falls off the bottom. Every value stays /64 so it is delivered at its labelled size. The stage-2 window band moves with it: 1664x960 is 1.60 MP and the 243-frame ceiling was only ever measured at 1.03 MP (91% of a 16 GB card), so the `< 1600000` boundary drops to `< 1100000` and the new tier takes the measured-safe 90 ceiling.
